hero.name: Abilash George Thomas
hero.summary: Backend and data platform engineer with 15+ years of experience building scalable APIs, distributed systems, streaming pipelines, and cloud software across retail, media, utilities, and enterprise platforms.

contact.label: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA

bullets: Contributed to Apple Online Store, Apple TV+, and machine learning or data streaming platforms.
Designed and delivered scalable APIs and data flows for high-volume product surfaces.
Partnered with multiple teams on integration, support, and delivery work.
Maintained and supported field maintenance applications built on Microsoft .NET.
Handled bug fixes, disaster recovery analysis, and platform improvements.
Built analytics platforms and streaming pipelines for manufacturing, retail, and insurance clients.
Worked on data modeling, transformations, Hive UDFs/UDAFs, and REST services.
Led development of a digital rewards platform for VTC on AWS.
Built cloud data flows, schema design, OAuth 2.0 services, and mobile integration support.

projects.title: Apple Online Store
description: Architected and implemented scalable, secure RESTful APIs for Apple Online Store marketing and sales workflows, including MacBook, iPhone, and iPad purchase flows, using Java and Spring MVC.
Integrated backend services with partner business modules and cross-functional systems; led design and code reviews and guided engineers through architecture tradeoffs.
Delivered new, unreleased product flows end to end, from design and implementation through testing and deployment.
Collaborated with business stakeholders to evaluate solution options, clarify requirements, and identify edge cases before implementation.
Used Claude and other AI-assisted engineering tools to support coding, documentation, GitHub workflows, deployments, and ticket tracking.
Owned on-call support for customer-impacting services, drove incident triage and root-cause fixes, and improved production reliability.

projects.title: Apple TV+
description: Built and maintained GraphQL and REST APIs with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and PostgreSQL for a distributed integration platform connecting Apple TV+ applications and data sources.
Owned end-to-end ingestion, transformation, and serving data flows and developed Retool UI tooling for rapid operational workflows and business coordination.
Worked with Title and Talent data associated with show production and media content operations.
Created a unified, centralized view of data that improved collaboration across pre-production, finance, distribution, and related departments.
Integrated Apple's custom authentication and security systems into the platform to support secure access and data workflows.
Built CI/CD pipelines with automated tests and containerized GCP deployments; mentored engineers and drove incident RCA, performance, and reliability improvements.

projects.title: Apple Machine Learning and Data Streaming Platform
description: Developed Java, Scala, and Python streaming and ingestion frameworks for anomaly detection and recommendation systems using Spark, Akka, Kafka, and Apache Iceberg.
Built ETL pipelines for streaming and non-streaming sources and added Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK-style monitoring, logging, and alerting.
Supported more than 700 TB annually and Kafka workloads up to 200 records per second per node; compaction reduced data volume by 50%+ and block count by 90%+.

projects.title: PG&E Field Maintenance Applications
description: Maintained Microsoft .NET and batch-script field maintenance applications in a production utilities environment.
Led on-call support, outage response, customer issue triage, root-cause fixes, disaster-recovery analysis, and system improvements.
Built automated responses using Amazon Lex to improve operational support workflows.

projects.title: TCS Analytics Programs
description: Built Java, Scala, and Python analytics platforms and real-time or batch ETL pipelines with Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, and Spring MVC for Voltas, FLSmidth, Nielsen, and Allianz UK.
Delivered data modeling, transformation, PySpark anomaly detection, reusable Hive UDFs and UDAFs, and migrated Hive and MapReduce workloads to Spark.
Integrated IoT data over MQTT and developed OAuth 2.0-secured REST services for reporting and visualization.

projects.title: Tagbond Platform (VTC)
description: Led end-to-end AWS development of Tagbond, a rewards and digital payments platform for VTC online training services using Java, Spring, PHP, HTML, and JavaScript.
Designed scalable data flows and MySQL/MongoDB schemas, and built OAuth 2.0 REST services with Android and iOS integrations.
Worked across the full stack on frontend and backend development and contributed to the platform's architectural design.
Traveled to the Philippines to collaborate with business stakeholders and support onsite implementation.
Coordinated delivery across teams in India and the Philippines, built the platform from the ground up, and supported it after release.
